plan.title: Bulk Apply RFP Template to Line Items

steps.note: Create an event with a Technical Stage.
Select an RFP template for the Technical Stage.
Verify the Technical Stage has an RFP template applied.
Create several line items so the bulk template action applies across multiple items.
Apply a template to the Technical Stage questionnaire sections, including the line-item sections.
Verify the bulk questionnaire/template operation completed without an application error.
